findings: Only decorator_overlaps_with_others production method changes; five native-physics test functions added.
Exact slot2 query, same existing collider shape and pose, default QueryFilter with actual predicate. No new registry, implicit flush, shape approximation or cross-slot scan.

Predicate resolves actual physical handle through existing strict generation/slot owner helper; tag3 required, destination Wall tag0, same full WallId, unsigned current ID != candidate, or current > candidate when ordered.
After physical hit the source is resolved again and returned by shared borrow from the canonical registry owner. Predicate does not return a copied guessed source.

Five tests use actual upsert/flush/remove and Rapier queries, covering empty/self/other-wall/non-wall/other-slot, canonical pointer identity, unsigned ordered ID, translated rotated shape, removal/reuse, invalid generation/source-kind. They have not been executed by reviewer.

No whole-workspace production caller of removed bool/mask API was evidenced in design preflight; incoming actual validation consumer signature was coordinated. Public API compatibility is deliberately narrowed to the proven original contract.
tests: five authored real Rapier tests unrun at review
limits: No whole-country-core typecheck, actual validation registration or scene runtime verified by this review.
An arbitrary malicious collider user_data pointing to another fully valid live entry is not a security property proved here.
Query order follows current existing pipeline; no ordering or implicit pipeline flush added.
Expected panics in fault-injection tests are not a supported catch-and-continue application contract.
